Sub-population information

Source: R/data.R
subpop.Rd

Sub-population information of samples. This data was published by Zhao et al. (2011) <doi:10.1038/ncomms1467>

Usage

subpop

Format

A character vector.

Source

http://www.ricediversity.org/data/

Examples

data(subpop)
